fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami city commission actions and local politics, including discussion of police matters and upcoming elections/primaries. Coverage criticizes streetcar service and operations of the Miami Beach Railway (noted as a subsidiary of Florida Power & Light), and discusses municipal purchasing debates (domestic vs. foreign materials) and public facilities needs for visitors. Regular columns and local notes address tourism, entertainment and nightlife, prohibition enforcement, civic events, and community institutions (including the University of Miami), alongside political advertisements and notices (e.g., Miss Miami contest and candidate announcements).
